title: Canonical portfolio model
definitionOfDone: Projects have stable IDs, purpose, state, stage, next action, blockers and derived evidence freshness.
verificationMethod: Schema validation and local verification gate.

title: Local capture ledger
definitionOfDone: One phone review action appends a durable event and derived state reloads from data.
verificationMethod: Reducer tests plus local UI smoke check.

title: Current state synchronization
definitionOfDone: Code, tests, dashboard fixtures, handoff and current-stage documents agree on the verified stage and next milestone.
verificationMethod: Full verification gate, contradiction scan and read-only browser check.

title: Private runtime data-home contract
definitionOfDone: Public fixtures and private runtime data have an approved path, migration, backup, rollback and fail-closed contract.
verificationMethod: Reviewed contract with acceptance tests specified before migration code.

title: Agent run ingestion API
definitionOfDone: Agent can submit objective, result claim, changed files and evidence as proposed state.
